episodes.title: The Heirs of the Dragon
episodes.summary: Viserys hosts a tournament to celebrate the birth of his second child. Rhaenyra welcomes her uncle Daemon back to the Red Keep.

episodes.title: The Rogue Prince
episodes.summary: Six months later. Rhaenyra oversteps at the Small Council. Viserys is urged to secure the succession through marriage. Daemon announces his intentions.

episodes.title: Second of His Name
episodes.summary: Two years later. Daemon and the Sea Snake battle the Crabfeeder. The realm celebrates Aegon's second nameday. Rhaenyra faces the prospect of marriage.

episodes.title: King of the Narrow Sea
episodes.summary: Rhaenyra continues her search for a suitable match, Daemon returns to Kings Landing and stirs more trouble for the King. Rhaenyra learns a valuable lesson about desires and what it means to be a daughter of a King.

episodes.title: We Light the Way
episodes.summary: Daemon visits his wife in the Vale. Viserys and Rhaenyra broker agreements with the Velaryons. Alicent seeks the truth about the princess.

episodes.title: The Princess and the Queen
episodes.summary: Ten years after the wedding between Rhaenyra Targaryen and Laenor Velaryon, King Viserys survived his collapse and has now fathered 3 children with Alicent Hightower. Rhaenyra navigates Alicent's continued speculation about her parentage of children, while Daemon and Laena weigh an offer in Pentos.

episodes.title: Driftmark
episodes.summary: As the families gather on Driftmark for a funeral, Viserys calls for an end to infighting and Alicent demands justice.

episodes.title: The Lord of the Tides
episodes.summary: Six years later. With the Driftmark succession suddenly critical, Rhaenyra attempts to strike a bargain with Rhaenys.

episodes.title: The Green Council
episodes.summary: While Alicent enlists Cole and Aemond to track down Aegon, she plots a heavy political drama in Kings Landing to crown her first-born son. Amidst all the obstacles, the hand, the queen and their allies successfully names Aegon II to be the next king. Otto gathers the great houses of Westeros to affirm their allegiance.

episodes.title: The Black Queen
episodes.summary: While mourning a tragic loss, Rhaenyra tries to hold the realm together, and Daemon prepares for war.

episodes.title: A Son for a Son
episodes.summary: While Rhaenyra struggles to come to terms with her son's murder, in King's Landing, Alicent grows concerned that Aegon's Small Council may lead them to an all-out war. Larys suggests Aegon needs a new Hand, and Rhaenyra arrives at a fateful decision.

episodes.title: Rhaenyra the Cruel
episodes.summary: As Otto schemes to turn the public against her, Rhaenyra questions Daemon's loyalty. Meanwhile, Ser Criston Cole concocts a misguided plan for revenge.

episodes.title: The Burning Mill
episodes.summary: As ancient grudges resurface, Rhaenys suggests that Alicent may see reason while the men around her seek bloodshed. Ser Criston proposes a bold scheme. Daemon arrives at Harrenhal to raise an army for the Blacks.

episodes.title: The Red Dragon and the Gold
episodes.summary: In Rhaenyra's absence and with no word from Daemon at Harrenhal, Rhaenys tries to keep the peace on the Black Council as Cole mounts a campaign into the Crownlands. In King's Landing, Aemond continues to undermine Aegon's fragile hold on authority.

episodes.title: Regent
episodes.summary: Amid whispers of bad omens, the Greens consider how to fill a void on Aegon's Council, Jacaerys sets out on a rogue mission to strike a deal, and Daemon enlists Lord Willem Blackwood to help persuade the Brackens to bend the knee.

episodes.title: Smallfolk
episodes.summary: With few options left, Rhaenyra summons a trusted knight for a risky venture and plots with Mysaria to catalyze the smallfolk. Meanwhile, Daemon's unease grows, and Aemond takes steps to reshape the Green Council.

episodes.title: The Red Sowing
episodes.summary: As Rhaenyra looks to gain an advantage by unusual means, Daemon pressures a young liege lord to raise up his bannermen.

episodes.title: The Queen Who Ever Was
episodes.summary: As Aemond becomes more volatile, Larys plots an escape, and Alicent grows more concerned about Helaena's safety. Flush with new power, Rhaenyra looks to press her advantage.

episodes.title: Salt and Sea, Fire and Blood
episodes.summary: Driven by her faith in Alicent, Rhaenyra positions herself to take King's Landing while the Triarchy sails to take on Corlys in the Gullet.

episodes.title: Queen's Landing
episodes.summary: As Alicent risks everything to fulfill her end of the bargain, Rhaenyra must decide whether the Iron Throne is worth the cost.

episodes.title: Rhaenyra Triumphant
episodes.summary: Rhaenyra learns the situation in King's Landing is not what she anticipated. Unable to locate her enemies, and with demands coming from all sides, Rhaenyra must navigate a delicate balance between appeasing her supporters and consolidating her rule.

episodes.title: Tumbleton
episodes.summary: Ormund's invasion of Tumbleton forces Rhaenyra into a corner.

episodes.title: Unbowed and Unbent
episodes.summary: As the search for Aemond and Vhagar continues, Daemon attempts to control the spiraling situation in King's Landing.

episodes.title: Faceless Men
episodes.summary: While Rhaenyra and Daemon focus on how best to deal with Ormund, tensions among their neglected allies begin to erupt.

episodes.title: The Dragon in Winter
episodes.summary: Torn between Mysaria and Daemon's visions for her reign, Rhaenyra grows desperate for a sign that she will prevail.

episodes.title: The Treasons at Tumbleton
episodes.summary: Shifting alliances irrevocably reshape the war as Rhaenyra's forces converge around Tumbleton and both sides vie to gain the upper hand.
